productSections.label: STANDARD FEATURE

features.description: Track and audit configuration changes with alerts to prevent unauthorized modifications.

features.title: Compliance & Security Audits
features.description: Automate compliance reporting and ensure adherence to industry standards and regulations.

features.title: Centralized Dashboard & Reporting

features.title: Low Total Cost of Ownership
features.description: No additional hardware required, minimal entry cost, and a maintenance-inclusive model ensure low total cost of ownership.

personality.buyer: Administrators, IT teams, MSSPs, and network security/compliance owners
personality.reasoning: Firewall Analyzer is a security operations product, so the visual language should feel authoritative and structured rather than flashy. The brand palette is limited to ManageEngine's orange, black, white, and soft grey, so the page should build a distinct identity through contrast, sharp layout rhythm, dashboard-inspired sections, and premium operational details. The hero should use the brand orange as a high-energy trust anchor, while the rest of the page alternates between clean light sections and deeper dark monitoring panels to reflect visibility, alerting, and forensic depth.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long (16+ words), so it should be compact and highly legible without overcrowding the split layout.

colours.colourReason: The palette is derived exclusively from the provided ManageEngine brand colors: orange for primary CTA and hero, black for authority and contrast, white for clarity, and light grey for separation. No outside colors are introduced.

layout.heroReason: A split hero lets the page show product credibility immediately with an abstract firewall dashboard or UI shell on the right while keeping the long headline readable on the left. The orange hero makes the page unmistakably brand-owned and high-impact.
layout.featureReason: The content has 5 core features plus 4 standard features and multiple additional benefits, so a spotlight section followed by a structured grid and alternating panels keeps the page readable while still feeling premium and interactive.
layout.darkSectionFor: Use dark sections for monitoring, compliance, and forensic-proof areas to create strong contrast and mimic a security console environment.

personality.imageryDirection: Use an abstract firewall-monitoring dashboard visual on the hero right side: layered UI cards, log streams, alert badges, and network rule panels. For feature sections, prefer SVG icons with precise linework and small PNG UI snapshots if available. Include floating chips for capabilities like 'Real-time alerts', 'Log forensics', 'Compliance reports', and 'Rule optimization'. Avoid stock photos unless absolutely necessary; the product should feel software-native and operational.
personality.designPersonality: A sharp, security-first enterprise interface with orange authority, clean operational spacing, and console-like depth. It should feel trustworthy to IT admins and MSSPs, with premium dashboard cues, evidence-style detail, and visually intelligent contrast rather than generic SaaS gloss.
